t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 4 pairs of gnomes, orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow, blue & purple.orange, green, red and blue lead to the bright forest, the other ones lead to a dark forest. the amount of mushrooms in the forest change, try to go to the forests with the higher mushrooms. focus even more on the x5 rounds. the size or style of gnome is irrelevant.

vb_textbox.text: Hello! Hope you're well!So basically the gnomes come in colour pairs.Red & YellowOrange & BrownGreen & PinkBlue & Purple1 from each pair will lead to the Bright Forest, and the other will lead to the Dark Forest.Red, Orange, Green and Blue gnomes lead to the BRIGHT FOREST with a RED BASKET.Brown, Pink, Yellow and Purple gnomes lead to the DARK FOREST with a YELLOW BASKET.Your task is to find the forest that yields the most mushrooms. It can change, but it will stay the same for a while. The main thing to focus on is which forest you're going to.It'll be hard to remember the colours, but the brighter colour (bar yellow) leads you to the bright forest, with the others leading to the dark. As you go through the game you'll be easily able to remember which colour comes with what forest. Just remember to be fast, as if you're too slow you'll get no points for that round. Especially be focused on the x5 multipliers!The style of the gnome doesn't change anything, it is purely the colour of the gnome that you need to focus on. Follow these rules and you'll get lots of mushrooms!!
